projet3.title: Creation of an accessible and ergonomic digital solution for a client.
projet3.description: I led the complete redesign and migration of a legacy e-commerce platform serving over 50,000 active users. This project involved modernizing an outdated architecture, implementing responsive design principles, and integrating third-party payment solutions. As the project manager, I coordinated between the development, UX/UI, and business stakeholder teams to ensure a seamless user experience while maintaining data integrity throughout the migration process.
projet3.challenge: The current Ohmyfood website no longer reflected the desired brand image: outdated design, poor user experience, and lack of accessibility. The challenge was to propose a modern, cohesive visual identity while designing a clear user journey for customers seeking to quickly and intuitively book a restaurant.
projet3.solution: I began by analyzing the existing visual identity and provided specific recommendations to create a new visual identity aligned with their positioning. I then designed two personas representing the target users, followed by a complete user flow to map their entire journey on the site. The ergonomic guidelines formed the basis for creating wireframes and graphic mockups in Figma, focusing on three key screens: the homepage, the 'About Us' page, and a 'Restaurant' page including a reservation form.

projet4.title: Development of the OhMyFood WordPress website based on UX/UI mockups
projet4.description: Following the validation of the mockups created in the previous project, I handled the full development of the OhMyFood website on WordPress to meet the client's deadlines. I integrated the main pages, developed key features, ensured accessibility, and produced complete technical documentation for the client.
projet4.challenge: The challenge was to transform Figma mockups into a functional, secure, and accessible WordPress website without using a page builder, while mastering new languages (HTML, CSS, PHP, JavaScript) and building on a partially prepared codebase.
projet4.solution: I configured WordPress locally, imported the provided architecture, and integrated the mockups by developing a child theme. I carried out responsive integration for the 'Home', 'About', and 'Restaurant' pages, developed a contest pop-up in JavaScript, implemented two forms (reservation + contest entry), optimized accessibility via Lighthouse, added a security extension, and exported the site for delivery. Finally, I wrote detailed technical documentation covering CMS choices, plugins, code structure, and maintenance best practices.

projet6.title: Brand Content and Social Media Strategy for Éclat Lifestyle
projet6.description: As part of a school project simulating a corporate assignment, I developed the brand content strategy for the premium lifestyle brand, Éclat Lifestyle. The project included analyzing an Instagram Ads campaign, creating a strategic brief, designing a quarterly editorial calendar, and producing optimized organic and paid content.
projet6.challenge: The brand lacked visibility in a highly competitive market. The challenge was to identify weaknesses in their current communication, optimize their social media campaigns, and propose a strategy that aligned with their premium positioning — all while respecting realistic budgetary and editorial constraints for an SME.
projet6.solution: I started by analyzing the latest Instagram Ads campaign, evaluating its performance (KPIs, targeting, formats, messages), and identifying areas for improvement. I then built a comprehensive brand content strategy: goals, targets, key messages, editorial line, channels, formats, AIDA method. This strategy was translated into a three-month editorial calendar. I also produced the first three organic content pieces and designed a new Instagram Ads campaign (mock-up), optimized according to best engagement and conversion practices.

projet8.title: Deployment of a Complete SEM Strategy for Éclat Lifestyle
projet8.description: As part of a professional simulation, I refined and implemented the SEM strategy for Éclat Lifestyle. The challenge was to turn a global marketing strategy into concrete, operational, and measurable SEM actions using different professional tools (GA, Google Ads, CRM, Mailchimp) while producing a compelling presentation for the executive board.
projet8.solution: I started by analyzing the data from Google Analytics and the SEO audit to define priority recommendations: keywords, technical optimizations, UX, and content. projet10.title: Designing Data Infrastructure and Analysis Tools for ArtisanConnect
projet10.description: In this project, I led the complete creation of the data infrastructure for ArtisanConnect, a marketplace dedicated to local artisans. I designed a UML schema structuring the entire system, developed SQL scripts to create and populate the database, defined user roles according to security principles and GDPR, integrated an AI-based customer feedback analysis system, and created a decision-making dashboard in Looker Studio.
projet10.challenge: The company needed a solid, secure, and GDPR-compliant database while integrating advanced analysis capabilities via AI to quickly process user feedback. The main challenge was to address both technical aspects (UML modeling, SQL, AI, data visualization) and strategic issues (management, security, data governance), making the entire system usable for the Tech team.
projet10.solution: I analyzed the provided dataset to identify the key entities of a marketplace (clients, artisans, products, orders, reviews, etc.). I then designed a normalized UML schema and translated this model into complete SQL scripts to create and populate the SQLite database. I defined user roles and access rules according to the principle of least privilege. Using the provided notebook, I integrated an AI-based customer feedback analysis feature (Mistral), which automatically detects the sentiment of each review. Finally, I designed a Looker Studio dashboard that allowed the director to track key KPIs.

Reduced stockouts by 45% through predictive analytics
Improved inventory accuracy from 75% to 96%
Reduced manual inventory counting time by 60%

Positive ROI within 6 months of deployment

projet11.title: Testing, accessibility, and deployment preparation for the ArtisanConnect website
projet11.description: In this project, I carried out the full testing phase of the ArtisanConnect back office and prepared its upcoming deployment. I created a structured test plan, evaluated ergonomics, accessibility, security, and GDPR compliance, then drafted a deployment plan, a maintenance plan, and a user guide intended for artisans.
projet11.challenge: The main challenge was to ensure the site's quality, reliability, and accessibility before its production release, while organizing a proactive and responsible deployment. This required analyzing an unhosted first prototype, testing every feature from the artisan's perspective, identifying issues, proposing fixes, and simultaneously structuring all required documentation.

projet13.title: Development of a comprehensive web marketing plan for the Hyatt Regency Paris Étoile hotel
projet13.description: In this project, I designed a complete digital acquisition strategy for a luxury hotel of the Hyatt group. This work included market analysis, persona creation, competitive audit, SWOT analysis, definition of SMART objectives, and the development of a SEO, SEA, and Social Media strategy aligned with the hotel's needs.
projet13.challenge: The hotel, recently renovated, needed to win back its usual clientele while attracting a more connected and international audience. The main challenge was to define an effective and cost-efficient strategy in a highly competitive market (luxury hospitality in Paris), while aligning acquisition channels with business objectives, premium traveler behavior, and industry standards.
projet13.solution: I began by defining four personas based on socio-demographic and behavioral criteria (premium families, leisure couples, international travelers, and digital nomads). I then conducted a full benchmark of three direct competitors to identify their SEO, SEA, social media, and partnership strategies. Based on this analysis, I created the hotel's SWOT matrix and defined SMART objectives for each acquisition channel. I then wrote an SEO roadmap, designed a multi-campaign SEA strategy, and developed a traffic-oriented social media editorial approach.

projet14.title: End-to-end management of a digital project using a hybrid methodology, "Hello Hercule" Application
projet14.description: This two-part project allowed me to lead the creation of a mobile application in the Food Tech sector, from the scoping phase to the agile management phase. I first applied the waterfall methodology to structure version 1 of the application: recruitment plan, RACI matrix, Gantt chart, calls for tender, and task planning. In the second phase, I switched to an agile approach by selecting a collaborative tool, building a product backlog, and creating both a validation plan and a risk prevention plan.
projet14.challenge: Designing and managing an ambitious digital project for a start-up from scratch, while combining two different methodologies (waterfall + agile). The main challenge was to precisely structure the roadmap, select the right partners, organize future collaboration smoothly, and secure the project through thorough risk anticipation.
projet14.solution: I began by defining the project requirements and structuring the team through a recruitment plan, then established roles and responsibilities using a RACI matrix. I then built a complete Gantt chart based on the phases of the waterfall methodology. I also drafted a call for tender for the marketing component as well as an evaluation grid for vendors. In the agile phase, I conducted a benchmark of five collaborative tools before selecting the most suitable one. I then created a structured Kanban product backlog with MoSCoW prioritization, a validation plan, and a risk prevention plan.

projet16.title: Eco-Innovative Digital Strategy and Specification for an AI Chatbot — Green Futur

projet17.title: La Brocante de Nanie — E-commerce Site
projet17.description: Designed and developed a complete e-commerce platform for a French antique dealer, from storefront to payment processing and order management. Built a custom admin panel allowing the non-technical client to manage products, orders, and shipping rules independently. The site went live at labrocantedenanie.com and handles real transactions.
projet17.challenge: The client had zero digital presence and no technical knowledge. The solution had to cover product management, secure payments, automated emails, dynamic weight-based shipping fees, and image hosting — all deployable on a budget hosting provider without a DevOps pipeline, while remaining fully manageable by the client without any developer intervention.
projet17.solution: Built a Next.js 14 App Router application with a CMS-style admin panel for full product and order control. Integrated Stripe with webhook handling for reliable payment processing. Implemented a weight-based shipping calculator driven by rules stored in the database and editable from the admin panel. Used Cloudinary for image hosting with automatic optimization, and Resend for transactional emails — customer order confirmations and admin sale notifications. Configured Supabase PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM and handled the Hostinger deployment constraints.
results: Delivered a fully functional production e-commerce site live at labrocantedenanie.com
Admin panel enabling the client to create products, manage orders, configure shipping rules, and track sales without any developer help
Automated dual-email system: order confirmation to customers and sale notification to the owner on every purchase
Dynamic weight-based shipping calculation replacing hardcoded frontend rates, configurable per product with a free-shipping toggle
Full production-ready storefront: clickable image gallery, category filtering, order tracking page, and legal pages

projet18.title: Artist Portfolio Website — David Rodriguez
projet18.description: Designed and developed a full-featured portfolio website for David Rodriguez, a Colombian-French visual artist based in Bangkok. Built a multi-page React SPA showcasing his exhibition collections, individual artworks, press articles, and a contact form, deployed at davidrodriguez.studio.
projet18.challenge: The site needed to present rich media content — exhibition carousels, embedded PDFs, individual artwork galleries, and video — across a highly varied set of screens, while maintaining a refined, gallery-level aesthetic and fast load times for an international audience.
projet18.solution: Structured the app around a nested React Router hierarchy matching the artist's content model (Collections → Exhibition → Artwork/Article). Used Framer Motion for staggered entry animations, Embla Carousel with wheel gesture support, and React PDF for inline press article display. Implemented WebP + JPG fallback pairs for all artwork images and sanitized HTML-rich content with DOMPurify. Integrated Formspree for serverless contact form handling.
results: Delivered a fully deployed production website at davidrodriguez.studio covering two collection types, two complete exhibitions, and seven press articles
Built a scalable JSON-driven data model allowing new exhibitions and artworks to be added without code changes
Implemented SEO foundations including Schema.org markup, Open Graph and Twitter Card meta tags, and dynamic page titles via React Helmet
Achieved responsive layout across mobile and desktop with a custom hamburger menu and adaptive column grids
Integrated PDF viewing, video autoplay in carousels, and WebP image optimization within a single coherent design system

Responsive UI design for media-heavy content
